ATTRIBUTE.Name: Slide ID
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A unique identifier of the Slide.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: The uniqueness refers to the context of the dataset.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVEAT: During dataset creation the submitter must use the Object Attribute “alias” to state a unique identifier, however, during the submission process that repository automatically generates a unique accession ID for each submitted CMMS Entity. This accession ID will be automatically injected into the XML file using the xs:attribute “accession” by the repository during the upload process. Once an accession ID has been generated all references to a given CMMS Entity must use the xs:attribute “accession” and not the xs:attribute “alias”.

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Created From
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The ID of the Block the Slide was created from.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVEAT: During dataset creation the xs:attribute “alias” must be used to reference a given CMMS Entity if the given CMMS Entity has not received an accession ID by the repository yet (I.e. Non-Complementary Datasets). However, during the submission process the repository will assign unique accession IDs to every CMMS Entity and internal references will be updated using the newly generated accession IDs by injecting them into the XML files. Once an accession ID has been assigned to a given CMMS Entity the xs:attribute “accession” must be used to reference the given CMMS Entity. This especially relates to Complementary Datasets, where only the xs:attribute “accession” must be used (also during data set creation) when an accession ID exists for a given CMMS Entity.
